item.title: Community Outreach Junior Staff Recruitment - Applications OPEN: Re: Community Outreach Junior Staff Recruitment - Introductions Sub-team
item.content:encoded:
Hey there! I've been interested in doing this for quite some time now, so here goes nothing! :)

► Application info
▼ Application info

Why do you want to be a junior staff on Community Outreach?

I would like to join the Community Outreach Team to help people find their way around the sometimes confusing nature of the Wiki and the SCP Universe itself.

I believe that the SCP Wiki is the most impressive collaborative effort even undertaken by people on the internet - a place born out of passion and pure creativity - and I would like to help make this wonderful thing as good as it can possibly be. I've seen too many people get turned-off on being invested in all stuff-SCP after a couple of moments within the community due to confusion about certain parts of it or just a general feeling of being overwhelmed, and I would love to do my best to prevent that sort of events from happening.

I try to be involved in as many community events as I can - from contests to the Art Exchange - I would love to help to organize such. Bringing this massive community together in new ways that would make people excited for all content SCP-wise would be a dream.

How active are you?

I'm active on-site every single day - although my activity is mostly focused during afternoon and evening hours, I try to keep in touch with the community whenever and however I can. Additionally, I am very active on SCP-related Discord servers, such as Dr. Cimmerian's Discord Server, /r/SCPDeclassified Discord Server, and Site-42 Discord Server - I engage with conversations going on in such almost constantly throughout the day. I try to read and give idea/draft critique on the said platform to every single request I can possibly put in my schedule - anyone who wishes to obtain help in any way related to the SCP Universe or writing for such can find it within my DMs or in the mentioned servers by simply @-ing me.

Additionally, I read a lot. Unless I'm really busy (which doesn't happen very often), I try to read almost every single article showing up on the Newly Created Pages thread. I also check up on the O5 Command forums once in a while to see how staff functions since these topics have always interested me.

Thought most of my activity circles around Discord due to its relative ease in access on both PC and mobile, I also try to reply to as many Idea Critique and Draft Critique as I possibly can on-site and on IRC when I have a free day - though I'm not a frequent user of the second platform, whenever I enter it, I am more than happy to help people with their writing and/or questions about the SCP Universe.

How can we contact you? Wikidot, IRC, and/or Discord?

As mentioned previously, the place I'm most active on is Discord - I go there by Kein#5142; when contacted there, I am going to reply within 1-2 hours unless I'm currently sleeping (my timezone is GMT+1). I will also notice all Wikidot messages since I check any and all sent to me regularly. IRC is not really my thing, so it isn't the most efficient place to contact me, but I will pop-in to check things out there once every couple of days.

Edit: I have heavily familiarized myself with IRC since the creation of this message; throughout the next couple of days, I will be trying to implement it as heavily as Discord into my lifestyle, spending equal amounts of time on both platforms.

If there are any more questions, I would be more than happy to clear things up. Thanks for considering me!

item.content:encoded:
SCP-8839-J is the 'light theme' for foundation messaging system 'SCiPNET'. Whatever entity or force of nature created SCP-8839 is, according to foundation analysis, in-human, and is likely more powerful and more evil than every other object in and out of containment, combined. SCP-8839-J is the most dangerous cognitohazard ever discovered, and as such is considered a "Class Φ Cognitohazrd"1, the only of its kind. According to the SCPF IT help desk "SCP-8839-J can be activated by clicking the Cognitohazard - Automatic Removal button on your SCiPNET terminal, scrolling to Cognitohazard - Automatic Removal and clicking the button 'light theme'".

Deleted at -15 and three votes.

SCP-5314 refers to 127 anomalous instances of Gallus Gallus domesticus of the ''Leghorn" race. SCP-5314 instances are sapient and demonstrate an ability to organize themselves as a society. All SCP-5314 instances follow the same religion and spend the majority of their time practicing it. Documents made by instances of SCP-5314 call it the ''Fellowship of the glorious egg''.

Deleted at -14 and three votes.

Feedback Ported:

cybersqyd

+ show block
– hide block

The idea of the chickens effectively re-enacting the story of jesus isn't like, necessarily a bad idea here; but the execution feels…really lacking? The break-neck pace of the story telling and the complete lack of commentary on the story combine to mean this has no impact on me as a reader. Like, if this was making some kind of point about Christianity or the forming of religions as a whole, then maybe I could vibe with it. Alternatively, having some kinda unique spin on the story and really giving us a sense of charm towards the characters in the style of e.g. SCP-4693 could help kick this over the line.

item.content:encoded:

Names:
Broken Drifty, Kwitty_nutsune, sensei_drifty_, summer_drifty, sensei_hanzo_, depressed_drifty, depressed_drifty_v1, riftstorm_drifty_v2, refstorm_drifty_v3, kwitty_meowscles, riftstorms101_king_driftyv7, riftstxrn_drifty, prince_drifty, depressed_drifty_v2, drifty_da_broken_kitsune, Kitsune_drifty, ripper_the_indoraptor.

Deleted at -22 and three votes.

SCP-5156 is a six foot tall humanoid entity with completely white eyes, a black body, and a crown.

SCP-5156 is able to merge with anything by going into the brain and controlling the person from the inside, this rarely happens.

Deleted at -21 and four votes.

Feedback Ported:

7ballcraze

+ show block
– hide block

So let's start

SCP-5156 is to be kept in a 1767.84 centimeters wide cell with special NORA security cameras and iron doors due to SCP-5156's exceptional strength.

What. 1767.84 centimeters? Why so specific? If the cell is 1767.85 will it die? This is a common problem with SCPs (heck I've done it a few times before), you don't need to specify the lengths of the cell. You can just say "SCP-XXXX is to be contained in a humanoid cell."

SCP-5156 is a six foot tall humanoid that looks roughly like a king with white eyes.

Huh? Looks roughly? Weird. Also looking like a king could mean anything. It could be an Egyptian king or a British king etc. You can just say "SCP-XXXX is a humanoid creature that wears a crown (or whatever it is wearing). SCP-XXXX's eyes are completely white as well."

SCP-5156 is able to merge with anything granting it the body and/or powers due to it's virus.

Ok first off, the footnote could have easily been in the paragraph. Think of footnotes like parentheses. Next, what do you mean by merge with anything? Does it do a body snatcher and replicate them? Or is it like the Thing where it kill and replaces the person. Also what's "it's virus"?

SCP-5156 can speak english, spanish, and french. SCP-5156 is very intelligent and is able to learn very quickly.

I believe the words English, Spanish, and French should be uppercase. Also this is kind of bland to be honest. Like cool it's very smart, it's never brought up again. It just feels like a X-man architype.

SCP-5156 can't attack the person they morph into due to being in the body and if the body SCP-5156 is in gets destroyed so does SCP-5156.

How do they know that? Did SCP-5156 tell them? I guess this is the only "downside" it has. Think of humanoid SCPs as something great (seeing into the future) with unsuspecting consequences (you can't look at food because it will look like feces). That's what made SCP-187 a good SCP since it's a monkey's paw effect. I suggest you also look into more modern humanoid SCPs since SCP-187 is kind of old (but still not terrible).

SCP-5156 was first discovered on 11/██/███ in a factory at ██████ and was found by J████ B████ during a security search at the █████ factory. SCP-5156 was trying to attack J████ B████ due to unknows reasons. SCP-5156 was in a 6 foot box when found for unknown reasons.

Uh, I feel like it was redacted a little too much. I want to at least know the mysterious JB's first name. Also, the factory could've been named to give the SCP more life and interest. Since you would want to know more about the factory. Also did the month have to be blocked out in the date? It seems really silly.

██████: Hello SCP-5156 today you are here so we can find out why you were in a box got it?

Commas can sometimes be annoying but in conversations it can act as a break in a sentence. If I read this sentence out loud then it would be a mouthful. The way I'd put it is "Hello SCP-5156, we have some questions we want to ask."

well I fell out of her body and into the box everybody said I was too dangerous and just kept me in there with the lid closed.

First, well should be capitalized since it was the first word in a sentence. Second, how strong is that box? Earlier you said they had to get iron doors (I think the SCP sites do have iron doors on all SCP cells though) and this smart guy gets trapped in a box? This is also after everyone said he was too dangerous.

After the interview SCP-5156 was taken back to it's cell and the research team started to see if they could get more information about █████████ ██████████ no progress has been achieved.

It's means it is. Its is for referring to objects that posses something. For example, its got a minifridge.

Subject: D-34734
Time: June 27th 4:43 PM EST

The Subject and Time have to be bolded.

Result: SCP-5156 went into D-34734's body as planned and started causing chaos. While the chaos happened a guard removed SCP-5156 from D-34734's body

What kind of chaos? Just saying causing chaos makes the reader less interested in the story.

Analysis: SCP-5156 can cause chaos inside a body but it it very easy to stop.

First you said it was dangerous, and now it's just easy to stop? This is a bit confusing. I suggest going to the forums for help on making your SCP.

As a courtesy to our readers on mobile devices, please collapse long posts. ~Zyn

SCP-5215 is a remote village named "Kaisariana" approximately ████ km south of the ████ border. At a first inspection, it looks like an ordinary village but when closer at about 100 meters from the entrance the subject enters a different dimension. In said dimension the subject(s) enter a comatose state for about 20-30 minutes, upon waking up observations show very light memory loss only including the last 12 hours of their life. Once awoken subjects are in a recovering state and can barely move. Once recovered their brain thinks that they were in this situation beforehand and were injured due to memory loss. Some of these "situations" are the following: World war 1 and 2, the Vietnam war, the cold war, the Afghanistan invasion, Iraq, etc. These anomalous events only occur under circumstances that are not yet known. The SCP-5215 population is around 70 people which are to be labeled SCP5215-2. Said subjects usually pass the age of 60 but all of them show advanced metabolism, motor skills, and huge life spans reaching up to 300000. Three of these inhabitants however retain abilities that can potentially cause a lot of damage should a total containment failure occur, therefore they are to be labeled SCP-5215-1 instances (check addendum 5215-A B and C). However, these SCP-5215-1 instances show to be more advanced at everything and potentially be immortal. Said instance is extremely hard to contain due to it being extremely resistant to most forms of physical damage, very intelligent, and immune to the effects of every other SCP.

Deleted at -14 and three votes.

SCP-5920 is a small “teddy bear” like object in the form of an elephant. SCP-5920 appears to have a fluffy texture typical of most “teddy bear” objects and has been reported to feel like it has stuffing inside of it. SCP-5920 is estimated to be roughly 12cm tall and 8cm wide. With the length of from the end of its tail to the end of its trunk being presumed to be roughly 16cm. SCP-5920 has the basic features of an elephant however they appear toned down to create a more appealing and “cute” (as described by D-class personal) looking object.

Deleted at -14 and three votes.

item.title: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!: Re: 9th Annual Holiday Art Exchange~!
item.content:encoded:
Okay, this is probably the first one of these I actually have time for, so I might as well put my name down.

What I can give: I can write SCPs or tales, although I'm better at the former. I lean towards concept-driven articles rather than sappy emotional stories. I'm also a cellist, for what that's worth.

What I am looking for: I will take art or an article featuring any of my solo SCPs (SCP-2801, SCP-3631, or SCP-4943), but I would especially like an article featuring my home-grown GOI Ravensgate Security Services. The short version is that they are a security firm that does pentesting, consulting, etc. for other GOIs, including the Foundation. I don't expect them to get very big - they are admittedly very niche - but I do want to flesh them out. For characters, you could include David Keyes's team, or you could write your own. The organizational structure isn't very well defined so far, so you have some freedom on that front. All I ask is that they remain a benevolent force, or at least a neutral one.

item.title: Deletions 69: the seventh most populous urban area in France: Re: Deletions 69: the seventh most populous urban area in France
item.content:encoded:
SCP-5245 consists of a ceramic mask with blank eyes and a wide smile, in addition to a black substance which is, at rest, the consistency of a borax-glue “slime” mixture, though 5245 can change this consistency at will. The amount of this substance varies proportional to feeding habits, though 5245 claims to be uncomfortable with less than 10.7 liters of fluid, and should thus be maintained above that. Amounts less than 750ml of the substance can be separated from SCP-5245 with no ill effects, and is not physically active, though SCP-5245 can still feel when it’s touched and control its viscosity.This substance will turn into unglazed ceramic after approximately 1 hour if not reconstituted into 5245.

Deleted at -14 and three votes.
